title: A faster accelerated simulator: 10^18 steps for 0LB1LF, 1.2·10^20 from start B
text: A C++ port of the accelerated simulator rsim.py, with the same decisions and about 15 to 25 times its speed, finds no halt in 10<sup>18</sup> steps for 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1LF (a cell-by-cell C run: none in 10<sup>12</sup>), in 1.2·10<sup>20</sup> steps for the same table from start B, and in 1.8·10<sup>17</sup> steps from start D. The runs use exact rules and validated, unproved jumps.
